_doc: Systems designed but stubbed in stage 1. Each entry names the hook already in the code that a later stage plugs into. Not loaded by the game; kept with the data so designers and code agree.

tide_clock.plan: A Great Tide once per in-game year raises the sea; low rafts flood, new dive routes open. Needs a world water-level offset applied in Waves.height and the water/seabed shaders.

star_navigation.hook: weather/Sky.js star field + Highmark Beacon bearing on the journal chart
star_navigation.plan: Named constellations, a sextant item, the Beacon sweep period and bird flight as bearings; no GPS ever.

voice_of_the_deep.plan: Hydrophone mini-game: tune frequency and phase to decode Cathedral patterns into a glyph lexicon; unlocks ending (d).

raft_rituals.hook: Weather events + RaftCommunity NPC schedules ('festival' activity)
raft_rituals.plan: Each raft lights lamps / sings / ties knots before storms; joining gives rep and storm bonuses.

memory_dives.hook: Cask Street memory pool (sepia-blue filter + log)
memory_dives.plan: Touching objects replays a short 3D vignette from the flood in sepia-blue.

long_dark_night.plan: Once a year no moon or stars; everyone ties up; the glow is brightest; strange events.

ghost_rafts.plan: Dim translucent rafts where previous lives (or other players) lived, with messages and gifts (async shared worlds).

crew_and_boats.plan: Boat classes (skiff, runabout, trawler, salvage tug, sail clipper, own raft) with speed/cargo/crew/noise; hire crew with skills, loyalty and fears.

player_rafts.plan: Attach pieces, sails, gardens, rain catchers, workshops, defences; your raft becomes a base.

secret_societies.plan: Tideholders, Salvage Brotherhood, Quiet Hand with rituals, quests and hidden rewards.

justice.plan: Fines, confiscation, forced farm labour, exile to the Hush, raft trials by community vote.

new_game_plus.plan: Legacy items, harder Highmark, hidden endings for specific life paths.

cloud_save.hook: save/SaveSystem.js (versioned JSON; export/import already in the pause menu)
cloud_save.plan: Swap localStorage for a backend adapter with the same snapshot/apply interface.

rebindable_keys.plan: Options page to rebind; store overrides in Settings.
